title: pilosella levieri
intro: Pilosella levieri, commonly known as Levier's mouse-ear, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella levieri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and ulcers, and to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu.
